$comment: #1468 — the ONE list of runtime variables production's /etc/ds-platform/api.env must carry. Read by the api's production boot check (apps/api/src/config/env.schema.ts), by the release gate's `runtime-env` phase (tools/deploy/prod.mjs, from the shipped SHA's tree) and by the template parity test (infra/deploy/api.env.example). A variable without `when` is required by every release; `when.image` makes it required only when the release's service set ships that image. Adding a variable the api refuses to boot without means adding it here; tests fail otherwise.
